## About

Arqam is a self-taught developer and entrepreneur from Sahibganj, Jharkhand, India. Curious about how systems work, he is interested in technology, reverse engineering, software development, and product building—enjoying experimenting, breaking things to understand their underlying mechanisms, and learning by building real projects. Alongside his ventures, he is a high-school student currently in Class 12 at The Assembly of God Church School, Kolkata.
